panel.title: Legionnaire Application
panel.description: Apply to join the Imperial Legion. Your answers are only shared with the review team.

positions.name: Legionnaire Application
positions.description: Apply to join the Imperial Legion.

questions.label: Why do you want to join the Imperial Legion?
What do you think makes someone a good Legionnaire?
If a superior gives you an order you disagree with, what do you do?
If another Legionnaire starts causing trouble with a civilian, what do you do?
If someone insults you while you're on duty, how would you handle it?
If you make a mistake while following an order, what do you do afterward?
What is more important: following orders or doing what you personally think is right? Why?
Why should we accept you into the Legion?
